name: Bukavu

queries.query: Bukavu official land registry cadastral survey office map land parcels South Kivu DR Congo
queries.result: The DRC Ministry of Land Affairs lists Bukavu I and Bukavu II as cadastral land districts in South Kivu. The provincial government describes its ministry’s cadastral and land-title remit. Searches did not find a public parcel map or safe vector API.

queries.query: Bukavu cadastre foncier circonscription foncière Bukavu I Bukavu II parcelles carte Sud-Kivu
queries.result: Le Ministère national des Affaires foncières liste les circonscriptions cadastrales de Bukavu I et II. Le gouvernement provincial du Sud-Kivu indique que son ministère gère le cadastre et les titres fonciers. Aucun géoportail de parcelles ni schéma vectoriel public n’a été trouvé.

portals.observation: The DRC Ministry of Land Affairs lists Bukavu I and Bukavu II within South Kivu among its updated administrative/cadastral land districts.

South Kivu provincial government states that its Ministry of Infrastructure, Urbanism and Land Affairs manages provincial cadastre and land titles. The listed ministry seat is Uvira, so current Bukavu operations are not established by this source.
Provincial government identifies Bukavu as a city in South Kivu and lists its five communes; this binds the Bukavu-named land districts to the target city context.

The DRC public-service catalogue describes commune-level parcel numbering based on a property title/occupation document and parcel plan/sketch. This is a generic national service description, not proof of a currently available Bukavu endpoint.
